reported_symptom: Native 3x chip is a Premium-only option; user requests a regular speed button.

native_contracts.config: YTIGranularVariableSpeedConfig: minimumPlaybackRate, maximumPlaybackRate, stepSize are int32 percent values; defaultPlaybackRateOptionsArray holds PlaybackRateOption messages.
native_contracts.option: PlaybackRateOption: value int32, isPremiumUpsell BOOL, label string, priority int32. Only value == 300 is converted.
native_contracts.sheet: YTIPlaybackRateSelectorMenuSheetViewModel: maximumPlaybackRate float; defaultPlaybackRateOptionsArray and defaultPlaybackRateChipLabelsArray are YTIRenderer arrays.
native_contracts.selection: YTIPlaybackRateOptionViewModel: optionValue YTISelectionValue, onTap ELMPBCommand, optionText attributed string. Native regular builder sets floatValue but leaves onTap absent.
native_contracts.core: YTLocalPlaybackController.setupPlaybackRateClampingBoundariesAndMaybeSetPlaybackRate divides granular maximum by 100 and intersects it with engine maximumSupportedPlaybackRate.
native_contracts.abi_checks: Every runtime hook and dynamic GPB accessor uses the class-local RVHook/RVCan signature guards.

behavior: Enabled by custom_speed_menu. Copies speed configurations and sheet messages; clears only the 300-percent option upsell flag and its special onTap/custom upsell text. Adds a normal 3x option to native fallback config. Raises valid configured maxima below 3x to 3x; preserves higher maxima, minimum/step and backend capability limits. Normalizes serialized storage for C++ block consumers. Original messages and feature-disabled behavior retained.
diagnostics: playback_speed.three_x_option: config/option/sheet/serialization counts; current_snapshot and existing native selection readbacks show requested/observed rate.
